name: 3D Specular Hover Tilt Card
description: Pointer-tracking 3D perspective card with a dynamic radial specular highlight and automatic prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

preview.caption: Interactive live preview — move your pointer across the card to inspect the 3D tilt and specular highlight.

install: Copy tilt.html, tilt.css, and tilt.js into your project.
usage: Add data-otter-tilt to any card element; tilt.js binds pointermove/pointerleave listeners while respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

verification.label: Browser E2E & Sandbox Verified
verification.details: Verified in headless Chromium E2E (tests/library-e2e.test.mjs): renders cleanly inside opaque-origin CSP sandbox with zero console errors and automatic prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
